calibration_selection_rule: Compare sigmoid and isotonic on calibration only; select minimum Brier score with log loss tie-break and publish reliability support.
ensemble_selection_rule: Do not select an ensemble unless mean rolling-origin AP improves by at least 0.01, no temporal fold regresses, and calibration or policy utility improves; otherwise prefer one LightGBM.

entity_isolation_rules.cold_start: Separate challenge mapping; challenge customer and entity identifiers cannot appear in train.
entity_isolation_rules.primary: Chronological recurring-customer replay; every aggregate excludes the current event and future events.
entity_isolation_rules.source_rows: UCI orders may be sampled once per primary benchmark; final truth is stored only in the sealed lock directory.

final_opening_rule: Open v2 final truth exactly once only after shortcut, leakage, lane-separation, feature, model, calibrator, likelihood, policy, evaluation-code, dependency, and hash gates pass. Any failure retains v1 as primary.
label_generation_rules: Sample simulated serial false-claim labels from a bounded noisy combination of historical velocity, peer deviation, repeated nonidentical patterns, claim timing, reason inconsistency, entity context, cross-category escalation, and evidence inconsistency. Payment invalidity never determines the ML label and no observable feature may perfectly expose it.
policy_objective: Minimize declared simulated policy cost subject to at most 5% manual review, at most one verifier, at most 20% initial legitimate challenge on policy-selection data, and no autonomous adverse decision.
review_capacity_constraint: manual review rate <= 0.05 on policy-selection data
stop_conditions: Any ML case violates point-in-time payment validity or lacks complete prior-refund history.
Any forbidden field enters the model matrix.
Any single feature deterministically exposes the simulated label.
Permuted-label AP materially exceeds prevalence beyond sampling tolerance.
Chronological, maturity, compute-before-update, entity-isolation, or lane-contamination tests fail.
Any v1 or genuine Razorpay evidence hash changes.

temporal_model_selection.objective: mean temporal average precision - 0.10 * AP standard deviation - review-capacity violation penalty
